profile.name: Mustaq Sohail Shaik
profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.bio:
Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable, high-performance applications across modern 
distributed architectures. Proficient in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with strong expertise in RESTful API 
development, microservices architecture, and cloud-native application design. Experienced in building resilient systems using Docker, 
Kubernetes, AWS/Azure, and CI/CD pipelines, while leveraging SQL/NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB for efficient 
data management. Recognized for translating complex business requirements into robust technical solutions, optimizing system 
performance, and delivering reliable production-grade software in agile environments.
